title: Phase 1 hardening: Unit tests for FortniteApi, AlertEngine, Metrics, Islands contexts
description:
No domain tests exist — only default Phoenix controller tests. Need unit tests for:
- FortniteApi: parsing (valid response, malformed, null fields), circuit breaker open/close, 429 handling
- AlertEngine: threshold evaluation per maturity tier, cooldown logic, dead island detection
- Metrics: upsert idempotency, median computation, data maturity calculation
- Islands: get_or_create, link/unlink, count by role
acceptance_criteria: mix test passes with >80% coverage on domain modules; all parse paths tested including edge cases
close_reason:
All 56 domain unit tests pass. Fixed 3 production code bugs discovered during testing:

1. Ecto 3.14 on_conflict API change: Changed [set: [:fields]] to {:replace, [:fields]} in Metrics upsert functions
2. Decimal.new/1 doesn't accept floats: Added decimal_from_value/1 helper in AlertEngine and fixed parse_decimal/1 in FortniteApi to use Decimal.from_float/1 for floats  
3. get_or_create_island double-wrapping: Fixed {:ok, Repo.update()} → Repo.update() which was returning {:ok, {:ok, island}} instead of {:ok, island}

Also fixed save_alert/2 to properly handle atom→string severity conversion.

title: Island Growth Advisor — Full Implementation

title: Wire alert evaluation into polling pipeline + CRITICAL immediate delivery
description: AlertEngine.evaluate/1 exists but is NOT called from PollIslandJob. Wire it up: after metrics upsert, evaluate alerts, save to DB, and send CRITICAL immediately via Telegram. Also verify cooldown logic works end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: PollIslandJob calls AlertEngine.evaluate/1 after upsert; CRITICAL alerts sent to Telegram within 1 minute; cooldown respected (24h) and overridden when metric worsens >5%

title: Dead island state machine: grace period, weekly check-ins, auto-resume
description: AlertEngine.check_dead_island/1 exists but only detects null data. Need full state machine: 3 null polls (~1.5h) → first CRITICAL alert; keep polling 24h grace period; after day 3: stop daily summaries, switch to weekly check-ins; auto-resume when data returns + send revival alert.
acceptance_criteria: Dead island detected within 2 hours of data loss; grace period maintained for 24h; weekly check-ins after day 3; auto-resume with revival alert when data returns
